chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Childhood records of Red Nichols and Louis Armstrong
summary: He knew all the solos of Red Nichols's Five Pennies and Armstrong from records and could not choose between them.

bands.name: Red Nichols and His Five Pennies

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: You mentioned music that you heard of as a child, classical music on records, all the popular and jazz music.
Well, during that time it was Red

Nickels -- I have a vivid memory of Red Nickels and his Five Pennies. And Louie Armstrong. And I never could decide at that time who I liked, you know, the most. Louie or Red Nickels. I admired them both. And I used to know all of their solos, you know. But during this time, this is why -- who I was really listening to.
And you were (inaudible) and you mentioned the blues.
